name: dev-kit
description: Development conventions toolkit — Python (py-script/py-project), HTML/CSS/JS (FLOCSS, debug-fab, logging, mock), Next.js 16 App Router (implement/plan), and Markdown. Reference auto-injection via PreToolUse(Edit/Write/Read) in hooks/ref-inject/main.py; each reference file declares its own triggers via YAML frontmatter (paths/required/tools), cached in cache.yaml. PostToolUse tsc check gated by DEV_KIT_NEXT_TS_CHECK. v4.17.0: consolidate into hooks/ref-inject/, absorb ~/.claude/rules, single-boolean required, tools aliases, quote-optional paths.
